intents.name: account_access
intents.description: The customer cannot get into their account: locked out, password rejected, verification code not arriving, or the sign-in page will not let them in.

intents.name: account_manage
intents.description: Changing or administering an account the customer can already access: closing it, household members, addresses, registration details, settings.

intents.name: contact_request
intents.description: The customer is asking how to reach a human - a phone number, live chat, or an escalation path. They want a channel, not an answer.

intents.name: delivery_courier_issue
intents.description: A complaint about how the driver or courier handled the delivery: left in an unsafe place, signed for by someone else, damaged in handling, or stolen after being dropped off.

intents.name: delivery_late
intents.description: The order has not arrived yet and is past, or about to miss, its promised delivery date. Tracking still shows it in transit or processing.

intents.name: delivery_not_received
intents.description: Tracking says the package was delivered but the customer does not have it. Use this when the system claims completion and the customer disputes it.

intents.name: delivery_wrong_location
intents.description: The package went to the wrong address, wrong country, or wrong carrier facility, or the customer wants it rerouted to a different location.

intents.name: device_or_content_issue
intents.description: A device or digital service is not working: Echo, Alexa, Kindle, Fire TV, the app, Prime Video playback, or purchased digital content.

intents.name: fraud_or_unauthorized
intents.description: Someone has used the customer's account or payment method without their permission: orders, reviews, gift cards or recurring charges they did not make, or an account they believe is compromised. Not the same as a refund dispute, where the customer made the purchase themselves.

intents.name: item_damaged
intents.description: The item or its packaging arrived damaged, broken, or counterfeit.

intents.name: item_wrong_or_missing
intents.description: The wrong item arrived, or part of an order is missing from a package that otherwise turned up.

intents.name: no_action_needed
intents.description: Thanks, acknowledgement, or confirmation that a problem is resolved. Nothing is being asked for.

intents.name: no_response_received
intents.description: The customer completed a step they were asked to take, or is waiting on a promised email or callback that never came.

intents.name: order_status
intents.description: A question about an existing order itself - where it stands, how to cancel, modify, re-order, or start a return. Not about a delivery that has failed.

intents.name: other
intents.description: Does not clearly match any other intent, or is a fragment of an ongoing conversation with no standalone meaning; catch-all.

intents.name: pricing_or_promotion
intents.description: A dispute about price, discount, delivery-charge eligibility, or a promotion not being honoured. The customer disagrees with what they were charged or offered, not with whether a refund arrived.

intents.name: prime_membership
intents.description: Questions or complaints about the Prime membership itself - its benefits, renewal, cancellation, or whether the service justifies its cost.

intents.name: refund_status
intents.description: A refund was requested, promised, or issued and the customer has not received the money, or the amount is wrong. Includes payment method problems.

intents.name: service_feedback
intents.description: Feedback about the quality of support or service received, positive or negative, without a specific unresolved request attached.
